## Prepare to test electrical appliances

Follow this checklist, where appropriate, to ensure everything in a property is ready for electrical testing. Checklist: Purely Plug-in Appliances. This list is designed to focus your attention on everything required to ensure electrical testing can be completed on portable appliances held by:

- Tenants
- The local authority
- Students.

The checklist is designed to be used during your pre- or post-visit inspections. It is not intended for the tenant or student to use.

Ensure all test desks, measurement devices, testing equipment and PPE are included.

### Checklist: Purely Plug-in Appliances

- Are batteries installed correctly (registered pinned down)
- Are batteries discoloured
